column1: Section 4 — Route Generation Models (Requirement: models must be named + formula given; minimum 3 required)

column4: Which model maximizes business-priority capture within the day's budget?
column6: Engine: Google OR-Tools Routing Solver (CP-based), Orienteering / Prize-Collecting formulation
column7: Maximize SUM(Priority_Score(DC_i) x Visited(DC_i)) subject to: SUM(Travel_Time_Leg, Haversine-based, final) >= Min_Travel_Minutes (R1.2); SUM(Travel_Time+Visit_Time) <= Field_Minutes_Available (R1.1); COUNT(Visited) <= 5 (R1.7). No distance cap (OQ-13). Implementation: single vehicle, closed route (R3.3), one Time Dimension (cap R1.1, floor R1.2), AddDisjunction(node, penalty=Priority_Score(DC)) per candidate.

column4: Which model minimizes travel for a fixed high-priority stop set?
column6: Engine: custom Python — Nearest Neighbor construction + 2-opt/Or-opt local-search improvement, over finalized Haversine-based distances (R3.1)
column7: Visit_Set = TOP-K(Ranked_Pool, BY Priority_Score) where K = largest K such that a valid closed route satisfies R1.1/R1.2/R1.7; minimize SUM(Distance(Stop_i, Stop_i+1)) via NN construction + 2-opt improvement

column4: Which model blends priority-capture and travel efficiency?
column6: Engine: Clarke-Wright Savings construction + 2-opt, candidate stop-set chosen to maximize a blended score
column7: Blended_Score(Visit_Set) = alpha x Normalized_Priority_Captured(Visit_Set) + (1-alpha) x (1 - Normalized_Travel_Time(Visit_Set)). FINAL (OQ-18, self-resolved OQ-20): Alpha_Node = Alpha_Min + (Alpha_Max - Alpha_Min) x (1 - Normalized_Avg_Travel_Time_Node), where Normalized_Avg_Travel_Time_Node = (Avg_Travel_Time_Node - Min_Across_All_Nodes) / (Max_Across_All_Nodes - Min_Across_All_Nodes). CONFIRMED bounds: Alpha_Min=0.4, Alpha_Max=0.8, Global_Default_Alpha=0.6 (used where a node has insufficient history). Direction locked: higher historical travel time at a node -> LOWER alpha (leans Model 3 toward efficiency, since travel is already the scarcer resource and more likely to threaten the R1.2 floor there); lower historical travel time -> HIGHER alpha (leans toward priority-capture, since travel isn't the bottleneck).
column8: CONFIRMED — FINAL, resolved by design decision (OQ-20). Rationale in Decision Log.
column9: None — resolved. Direction and bounds can be revisited after a few weeks of live data if Model 3's behavior doesn't match field expectations, but this does not block build.
